verdict.rationale: Asaas is API-first. Charges, payments, subscriptions, subaccounts and webhooks can all be automated through its REST API using a static API key sent in a header, which suits non-interactive headless runs. A dedicated Sandbox environment lets automated pipelines test customer, charge, payment, transfer and webhook flows (including simulated payments and fictitious cards) before using production credentials. Missing for 10: no official CLI or SDK in the evidence, no explicit CI/CD integration guidance, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
